findings.what: The frozen contract's A2 says "phase stays split" and A3 says "keep refusing when activatedRevision !== null". The shipped behaviour (and the four doc twins) leaves the phase untouched — split for a first activation, executing for a partial re-split — and refuses a re-split only on the forward-only revision rule. Both A2's second bullet ("activatedRevision is NOT set") and A3's clause can only be coherent for a re-split if they mean "unchanged"/"forward-only", and the pre-existing re-split documentation already required a greater revision.
findings.where: .mpd/plans/cellwork-remediation-p1.md (A2, A3) vs docs/cellwork.md "A failed activation resumes" + packages/mpd-cellwork-plugin/README.md "Resumable activation"
findings.whyItMatters: The acceptance text and the shipped rule disagree on the re-split path; a later reader cannot tell whether the phase rule is an unstated amendment or a defect.
findings.direction: The captain (contract owner) amends A2 to "phase is left unchanged (never regresses)" and A3 to "refuse only when the accepted revision is not greater than the recorded one". No writer repair needed; behaviour matches the reasonable reading.
findings.disclosed: writer report §5.4 and docs-qa report D1

findings.what: No arm exercises a partial RE-SPLIT resume. The docs state the generic claim "A retry of the SAME accepted revision resumes from that record" and contract §1's goal is generic, but all seven §4 arms inject their failure on a FIRST activation; the re-split resume rests on the two lanes' symbol-level reading, not on P1 evidence.
findings.where: contract §3.1 A3 + §4 vs docs/cellwork.md "A failed activation resumes"
findings.whyItMatters: A re-split failure is the same class of wedge P1 exists to remove; if the forward-only/loop-reuse path regressed, the suite would stay green.
findings.direction: Add one arm next wave: a successful first activation, then a re-split whose loop-open fails after the second task, then the same-revision retry (no duplicate member/task/loop, phase unchanged, activatedRevision advances only after dispatch). Alternatively scope the docs sentence to first activation and declare the re-split path a bound.
findings.reasonNotBlocking: Contract §4's mandatory arm list is fully present and red→green; §4 defines the required evidence, and all of it is met.
